items.question: What alternative forms may a structure take, including an assembly-hall form or a water site?
premises: A structure may be joined with the form of an assembly hall.
A structure may alternatively be only that form.
A structure may alternatively be a water site.
items.inference: The permitted forms include an assembly-hall shape, that form alone, or a water site.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of jala-sthalam in this context is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: It may be shaped like an assembly hall, or be only that, or else be a water site.
